the ZnO nanorodes and nano/mesporous films are synthesized and characterized by using the solution-based method and the nanosensors made from these films are very sensitive and stable for detecting the gas molecules.

the synthesis of ZnO nanostructures and mesoporous materials for device applications.
the synthesis and characterization of ZnO nanoroids, nano/mesoprous films and their applications in gas sensors, photodetectors and solar cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the aqueous solution synthesis of ZnO nanoroids and mesoporous thin films is a simple and cost-effective method for large-scale fabrication of ZnO nanodevices.

ZnO nanorode arrays and mesoporous ZnO films can be synthesized by simple, low cost and environmentally friendly aqueous solution method, and can be easily integrated into various device applications.
ZnO nanostructures have great promise for a variety of applications in the fields of nanoelectronics, photonics, optoelectronics, and nanosensor technology.

we have successfully demonstrated the feasibility to synthesize ZnO nanorodes and nano/mesporous films using a low-temperature, aqueous-based solution technique, and to fabricate nanodevices with good performance.
the ZnO nanorode and nano/mesoporos films can be used for the fabrication of gas sensor, solar cell, light emitting diode and so on.
